Factor-Analytic Biplot for GxE Interaction

Source: R/plot.R
plot_fa_biplot.Rd

Produces a biplot from the factor-analytic (FA) decomposition of genotype-by-environment interaction effects estimated from B-spline coefficients. Environment loadings and variety scores are overlaid in a two-dimensional space showing the dominant patterns of GxE interaction.

Usage

plot_fa_biplot(
  model,
  factors = c(1L, 2L),
  point_size = 3,
  text_size = 3.5,
  ...
)

Arguments

model

An fda_model object containing FA structure in extras (e.g., model$extras$fa_loadings and model$extras$fa_scores), or with variance components that can be decomposed.

factors

Integer vector of length 2 specifying which FA factors to plot. Default c(1, 2).

point_size

Numeric; size of points. Default 3.

text_size

Numeric; size of labels. Default 3.5.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

Value

A ggplot object (invisibly), or NULL for base R fallback.

Details

The biplot displays:

  • Environment loadings as points/arrows, showing how environments differentiate varieties.

  • Variety scores as labelled points, showing relative variety performance across the FA factors.

If the ggrepel package is available, labels are automatically positioned to avoid overlapping. Otherwise, ggplot2::geom_text() is used.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
met_model <- fit_functional_profiles(sim_met_fda, ...)
plot_fa_biplot(met_model)
} # }
